title: MySQL integrated CDC: the per-table snapshot event never reports COMPLETED

found.by: 2026-10-26 rerun: MySQL 8.4.13, integrated CDC, tables with 0, 1, 3-then-deleted and 1,000 rows; every event page read up to 20 minutes after the update ended

symptom: Each table's operation event goes 'Snapshot of <table> has SCHEDULED', then 'IN_PROGRESS', and stops there. The extractor's snapshot flows report COMPLETED within seconds; the applier's snapshot flows stay RUNNING until the update ends (about 20 minutes later). Destination counts were right (0, 1, 0, 1,000).
cause: Not traced: the completion event in the applier isn't reached or is gated for this route.
effect: A tool or person waiting for 'Snapshot of ... has COMPLETED' waits forever.
fix: Use the flow_progress COMPLETED event of extractor_..._<table>_snapshot_flow, or count rows, to know a table's snapshot is read.
notes: Round 2 read only the first 250 events; this run read every page and saw the same.
